mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'iw') AS week FROM SYT0LP t1 WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -15) AND t1.YMD NOT IN (SELECT HOLI_YMD FROM SZX0HL ta WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'US' AND ta.HOLI_YMD >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -15)) ORDER BY ymd DESC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , t1.JM_CD AS jm_cd , t1.JONGA AS jonga , t1.TVOL AS syt0lp_tvol , t1.TVOL AS tvol , t1.TAMT AS syt0lp_tamt , t1.TAMT AS tamt , t1.SHAR AS syt0lp_shar , t1.SHAR AS shar , t1.TOMV AS syt0lp_tomv , t1.TOMV AS tomv , TO_CHAR(t1.LOAD_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS load_time , ya.JASAN_GB AS jasan_gb , ya.BLBG_TCKR AS blbg_tckr , ya.ISIN_CD AS isin_cd , ya.CURRENCY AS currency , F_JM_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.jm_cd) AS xx_yj_cd , F_JM_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.jm_cd) AS jm_nm , F_YJONGA(t1.CORP_GR, t1.jm_cd, t1.ymd - 1) AS jun_jonga , (t1.JONGA - F_YJONGA(t1.CORP_GR, t1.jm_cd, t1.ymd - 1)) AS diff_jonga , 1 AS p_visible FROM SYT0LP t1 , SYM0YA ya WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND ya.JASAN_GB = '1' ORDER BY CASE WHEN ya.BLBG_TCKR IN ('SPX','NDX') THEN '1' ELSE '2' END , t1.JM_CD
